name: Ogee
description: An ogee lattice - every tile rounded on one pair of opposite corners, flipping with the checker to draw the onion curve.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: 100% 0 100% 0; @even { border-radius: 0 100% 0 100%; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
